name: THE HOOK
spoken: They pay you two dollars to watch videos.

name: THE NUMBER
spoken: The machine behind that job was pulling in thirty million dollars a day.

name: THE SAME ENGINE
spoken: Same engine. Same script. Two dollars to watch, two hundred fifty to deposit.

name: THE BIGGEST PILE
spoken: In October twenty twenty five, American prosecutors took the biggest single pile of it ever: fifteen billion dollars in bitcoin.

name: THE PROMISE
spoken: Here's who was paying you. And how they got caught.

name: THE CARD
spoken: First, the offer. It arrives in your messages like every other side hustle.

name: THE TASK
spoken: Watch ten videos. Screenshot the proof. Send it in. Twenty dollars.

name: THE RATE
spoken: Two dollars a video. Less than minimum wage, and that is exactly the point.

name: THE CLEAR
spoken: See, the payment actually clears. Real money, into your balance, in eleven minutes.

name: THE CHECKLIST
spoken: Real app. Real payout. Support that answers in minutes. You tick every box.

name: THE BALANCE
spoken: The balance climbs. Twenty. Forty. A hundred. It never goes down.

name: THE TRAINING
spoken: Meaning the hook is the work. You aren't being paid to watch videos. You're being trained.

name: THE SUPERVISOR
spoken: Within two days, a supervisor appears. A group. A commission ladder.

name: THE PROMOTION
spoken: Congratulations, you've been promoted to VIP." That's the actual script.

name: THE LADDERS
spoken: Both ladders climb together: your earnings, and what you're asked to put up to reach the next rung.

name: THE CARD
spoken: The money that arrives first is the mechanism. It deserves its own minute.

name: THE TRUST
spoken: Instant payouts. A balance that grows. Support that answers. None of it was an accident.

name: THE COUPON
spoken: That first withdrawal isn't a payment. It's a coupon, and it costs them two dollars.

name: THE COST
spoken: They spend two dollars to learn what you'll risk. You spend two dollars to believe they're real.

name: THE TRADE
spoken: See, trust isn't built by the app. It's built by you, watching your own money arrive.

name: THE RECEIPT
spoken: The deposit clears, and you watch it. That's the moment the belief gets built, by you.

name: THE SUPPORT
spoken: Every question answered. Every time. A hundred staff, one conversation each.

name: THE WORD
spoken: In the trade, they call it fattening. Feed the account. Build the belief. The kill comes later.

name: THE LADDER
spoken: Each tier is a rung. Each rung is a deposit you haven't made yet.

name: THE RUNG
spoken: Then the rung that matters: two hundred fifty dollars, to unlock a faster payout tier.

name: THE REASON
spoken: And it works. People pay it. Because the balance is real, and the balance is theirs.

name: THE SERVER
spoken: Except the balance is a number on their server. The deposit is real money, moved.

name: THE SEGUE
spoken: Some of it gets paid out, to make the next person trust the same screen. The rest moves on.

name: THE CARD
spoken: The turn happens when the amounts stop being small.

name: THE FEES
spoken: A platform fee of ten thousand. An unlock of twenty. A tax clearance of forty.

name: THE VAULT
spoken: Every reason to deposit has one thing in common: it unlocks money that's already yours.

name: TWO MATHS
spoken: Their math: deposit to unlock. Your math: it's already in there. Two maths, one answer.

name: THE PSYCHOLOGY
spoken: The psychology is textbook. Sunk cost. Escape cost. The account is almost unlocked.

name: THE MOVE
spoken: But the balance is never unlocked. The rules change on the server, and the ask gets bigger.

name: THE SECOND LAYER
spoken: And for the biggest accounts, they add a second layer: romance.

name: THE CAST
spoken: A friend with a tip. A partner with a plan. An expert who always answers.

name: THE SLOW KILL
spoken: The best accounts are fattened for months. The slaughter takes an hour.

name: THE LINE
spoken: I love you. Trust me. Just this once." It's a script. It has always been a script.

name: THE RECEIPT
spoken: The deposit doesn't go to the platform. It goes to a wallet, and wallets leave receipts.

name: THE LAST FRAME
spoken: The last frame the mark sees: the balance, the chat, and silence.

name: THE CLOSED ACCOUNT
spoken: On their ledger, the account closes. The person stays open.

name: THE BROOKLYN NETWORK
spoken: In Brooklyn alone, one network moved millions for this machine, two hundred fifty victims across the country.

name: THE FUNNEL
spoken: A hundred thousand targets. A thousand responses. A hundred deposits. Five locked accounts.

name: THE CARD
spoken: Time to meet the machine that runs the numbers.

name: THE PLACE
spoken: The money doesn't land in a call center. It lands in Cambodia.

name: THE COMPOUND
spoken: Ten compounds. High walls. Barbed wire. Dormitories for hundreds of workers.

name: THE PHONE FARM
spoken: Phone farms: one facility alone held twelve hundred fifty phones.

name: THE ACCOUNTS
spoken: Seventy six thousand accounts on one platform, out of two buildings.

name: THE LEDGER
spoken: A ledger for every compound: which rooms run which scheme, and what each one profits.

name: THE LABOR
spoken: The labor was the product. Workers trafficked in, kept against their will, under threat of violence.

name: THE DATES
spoken: In twenty nineteen, the Golden Fortune compound went up. In twenty twenty one, millions of phone numbers and passwords were bought in bulk.

name: THE QUOTE
spoken: The founder of Prince Group, prosecutors say, bragged that the profit was considerable, because there is no cost.

name: THE SPOILS
spoken: The proceeds bought the usual: yachts, a private jet, and a Picasso through a New York auction house.

name: THE DIAGRAM
spoken: The laundering ran on a diagram. Split the coins across a hundred addresses, recombine them into three.

name: THE RECEIPTS
spoken: Every split is public. Every address is a receipt. The blockchain keeps the book.

name: THE CARD
spoken: October, twenty twenty five. The indictment lands in Brooklyn.

name: THE FILING
spoken: The chairman of Prince Group is charged with running the whole machine.

name: THE VERDICT
spoken: FBI Director Patel called it one of the largest financial fraud takedowns in history.

name: THE SEIZURE
spoken: A hundred twenty seven thousand two hundred seventy one bitcoin. Fifteen billion dollars. The largest seizure in DOJ history.

name: THE KEYS
spoken: How? The coins sat in wallets whose keys one person held. Take the keys, and the pile stops moving.

name: THE TELL
spoken: And the tell that generalizes: an investment you can't withdraw from without depositing more is not an investment.

name: THE RULE
spoken: Real money withdraws. Real platforms never unlock your own balance.

name: THE TEST
spoken: Ask to withdraw before you deposit. The answer is a number, and it's not yours.

name: THE CALLBACK
spoken: They pay you two dollars to watch videos.

name: THE NUMBER
spoken: This machine took in thirty million dollars a day.

name: THE PRODUCT
spoken: The pay was never the product. You were.

name: THE LINE
spoken: The trap is the trust. That hasn't changed.

name: THE PAYOFF
spoken: Paid to watch videos, until the pay becomes the price.
